title: Ambition alignment: mini experiments and backup plan
notes:
Context: spending Q1 prototyping small, time-boxed experiments to test a lateral move into product/people ops partnerships. Goal is to produce 2–3 credible signals for a conversation with my manager in March and a concrete fallback plan if we can’t get a role shift immediately.

Top-level measures (what would count as signal):
- One cross-functional mini-delivery with measurable outcome (doc + one metric) within 6 weeks.
- Positive 1:1 feedback from partner PM and eng lead (specific quotes saved).
- Clear list of skills learned + 2 artefacts to add to portfolio (playbook + template).

Candidate micro-experiments (pick 2):
1) Onboard sprint: design a 1-week onboarding checklist + pilot for a new hire in infra; deliver checklist + 1-hour walkthrough recorded.
   - Outcome metric: new hire NPS after week 1 >= 8/10.
   - Stakeholders: Priya (infra), Tom (hiring manager).
   - Risks: limited time; ask for 2 blocked days.
2) Metrics hygiene blitz: partner with Console team to scope token-cost dashboard improvements for two high-volume routes.
   - Deliverable: concise doc with 3 recommended queries + sample dashboard tile.
   - Outcome metric: dashboard adoption (2 teams use within 30 days).
3) Micro-runway for people ops play: draft a 1-pager 'manager checklist for calibration' and run 2 manager office-hours to test adoption.

Notes to self (voice):
- Keep experiments time-boxed (max 20% sprint time).
- Anchor asks to business outcome (latency/cost/QA) not just "I want to learn product".
- Save short clips of feedback (Slack snippets) and timestamped Looms.

Manager prep script (for March sync):
- Opening (30s): small experiment update + why it matters for team capacity.
- What I delivered (60s): one artifact + metric + 1 quote.
- Ask (60s): Request for either (A) formal stretch assignment for 3 months; or (B) sponsorship to pilot X with lead PM and documented handoff.
- Backup: If neither, propose a calendar block to run 2 more micro-experiments in next 6 weeks and reconvene.

Potential asks (phrasing):
- "Can I be assigned as the primary owner for the onboarding pilot — I need 2 full days and a direct contact (Priya) to unblock?"
- "Would you be open to advocating for a short-term stretch to partner with Console on the dashboard improvement so I can produce a product-ready artifact?"

Evidence capture checklist:
- Save Slack msg with time + copy into evidence doc.
- Loom recordings stored: /shared/looms/ambition-experiments/
- PR/Doc links added to Confluence experiment page.

Unresolved questions / friction points:
- How to quantify adoption quickly for things that have slow feedback loops? (ask analytics: quick signal proxies)
- Manager bandwidth: need to test whether ask is perceived as diversion from current commitments.

Next actions (this week):
- Monday: ping Priya + draft 1-pager onboarding checklist (2 hours).
- Tuesday: outline dashboard queries and ask Console owner for 30-min sync.
- Thu: record 10-min Loom summarizing experiment plan and drop in manager thread.

Quick evidence snippets (to copy into meeting):
- "Priya: 'This checklist saved me 45 minutes during onboarding' (Slack, 2026-02-02)"
- "Tom: 'This felt more actionable than previous attempts' (1:1 note, 2026-02-10)"

Filing + housekeeping: create a Confluence seed page (linked above) and add a short version to my personal portfolio. Keep this doc as working notes and collect items under 'evidence' folder.

Tone reminders: keep asks concrete, low-friction, tie to team priorities. When in doubt, ship tiny artifacts rather than grand plans.

Random scratch lines (brainstorm):
- "short runway" concept: 3 mini-experiments -> 1 portfolio artifact -> manager conversation.
- Consider pairing with an IC from Console for co-ownership (reduces perceived risk).
- If rejected, propose a 6-week pilot co-owned with a peer-level sponsor.

End of notes.
quick_asks: 2 days of focused time for onboarding pilot
Sponsor for short stretch assignment (3 months)
